gdc.format.lod.label: LOD detection
gdc.format.lod.tooltip:
Auto: trailing-number LODs (body200, Collision-1) when the scene has base*/start* nodes,
otherwise every mesh node is one object at a single detail size.
gdc.format.detailSize.label: Single detail size
gdc.format.scale.label: Animated scale
gdc.format.scale.tooltip: How scale keyframes are stored. Auto picks uniform or aligned per sequence.
gdc.format.exporter.label: Exporter id
gdc.format.exporter.tooltip:
Stored in the version word. The game uses a cached .cdae next to a .dae only when it is 124
(or the .dae is missing); 233 marks an Assimp import cache.
gdc.format.lodNames.label: Export LODs and collision
gdc.format.lodNames.tooltip:
From DTS/CDAE: every detail level becomes a node named <object><size> (body200, Colmesh-1)
under base01/start01, so importing it back restores the LODs. Off: highest visible detail only.

gdc.format.pointClouds.tooltip: Write meshes without faces as point clouds.
gdc.format.compression.label: Compression
gdc.format.compression.tooltip: zstd-compress the body. Auto compresses bodies larger than 512 KB.
gdc.format.zstdLevel.label: zstd level
gdc.format.dtsVersion.label: DTS version
gdc.format.dtsVersion.tooltip:
v29 is the current version and keeps everything.
v28 and older do not list part names at the start of the file. The game still opens them.
v27 and older also leave out bump-map directions. The game rebuilds those.
v24 and v25 also drop the second texture and painted colors, and one mesh cannot have more than 65535 points.
gdc.format.container.label: Container
gdc.format.unlimitedBones.label: Unlimited bones per vertex
gdc.format.unlimitedBones.tooltip: Write JOINTS_1.. sets instead of keeping only the 4 largest weights.
gdc.format.specGloss.label: Specular-glossiness materials
gdc.format.draco.label: Draco mesh compression
gdc.format.draco.tooltip:
Makes the .glb much smaller by compressing the mesh (KHR_draco_mesh_compression).
Vertex positions stay exact. Normals, UVs, vertex colors and tangents are rounded to the bit
counts below. Fewer bits = smaller file but less precision.
Joints and weights stay exact; points, lines and morph targets are not compressed.
The game's Assimp can read it, but some other viewers cannot.
gdc.format.dracoLevel.label: Draco compression level
gdc.format.dracoLevel.tooltip:
How high level of compression will be used to create a smaller file. Does not change quality or load speed,
only export time and size: 0 = fastest and biggest, 10 = slowest and smallest.
gdc.format.qNormal.label: Normal bits
gdc.format.qNormal.tooltip:
Shading-direction precision. One step is about (360 degrees / 2^bits): 10 bits is about 0.35 degrees.
Too low shows faceting and banding in highlights on smooth, shiny surfaces.
gdc.format.qUv.label: UV bits
gdc.format.qUv.tooltip:
Texture coordinate precision. Steps are (UV range / 2^bits): 12 bits on 0..1 UVs is half a texel on a 2048 px texture.
Raise it for 4K textures or UVs that tile far outside 0..1 (the range eats into the bits).
Too low makes textures swim, blur or misalign along seams.
gdc.format.qColor.label: Color bits
gdc.format.qColor.tooltip:
Vertex color precision per channel. 8 bits matches normal 8-bit color, so no visible loss.
Lower values band smooth gradients such as baked ambient occlusion or tint.
gdc.format.qGeneric.label: Tangent bits
gdc.format.qGeneric.tooltip:
Tangent precision, used for normal maps. Only tangents are affected; joints and weights are never quantized.
12 is plenty; too low makes normal-mapped detail shimmer or lights wrongly.
gdc.format.encoding.label: Encoding
gdc.format.transparencyFactor.label: Transparency factor refers to opacity
gdc.format.transparencyFactor.tooltip: Write TransparencyFactor as opacity (some tools read it that way).
gdc.format.mtl.label: Write .mtl material file
gdc.format.x64.label: 64-bit floats
gdc.model.warn.shape: %s%zu of %zu triangles line up, %zu of the original are missing, %zu extra were added. The farthest point moved %.3g (%.3g%% of the model size).
gdc.model.warn.shapeExact: %sEvery triangle lines up with the original (%zu).
gdc.model.warn.shapeClose: Some faces may be missing or doubled.
gdc.model.warn.shapeBad: Large parts were lost or added, so the model will look different or incomplete.
gdc.model.warn.shapeMissing: %sThe shape was not saved. The original has %zu triangles and the result has none, so this part will be invisible.
gdc.model.warn.shapeExtraOnly: %sThe result has %zu triangles that are not in the original.
gdc.model.warn.windingOk: %sFaces point the same way as the original.
gdc.model.warn.windingFlip: %s%zu faces are flipped inside out. They may look black or invisible from the front.
gdc.model.warn.normalsShift: %sShading differs by up to %.2f degrees, so highlights may sit in a slightly different place.
gdc.model.warn.normalsBack: %sShading is backwards on %zu spots, so those areas may look black. The biggest difference is %.2f degrees.
gdc.model.warn.edgesChanged: %sHard edges changed: %zu creases in the original, %zu smoothed away, %zu new. The model may look softer or sharper along those edges.
gdc.model.warn.normalsMissing: %sShading direction was not saved. Lighting is rebuilt and may look smoother or more faceted.
gdc.model.warn.uv0Ok: %sThe main texture sits in the same place.
gdc.model.warn.uv0Moved: %sThe main texture has moved. The biggest shift is %.3g, where 1 is the width of one texture tile, so the picture may not sit in the same place.
gdc.model.warn.uv0Both: %sThe main texture has moved (biggest shift %.3g, where 1 is one texture tile wide) and is upside down on %zu corners.
gdc.model.warn.uv0Lost: %sThe main texture placement was not saved, so textures will not wrap the model the way they did.
gdc.model.warn.uv1Ok: %sThe second texture (detail or lightmap) sits in the same place.
gdc.model.warn.uv1Moved: %sThe second texture (detail or lightmap) has moved. The biggest shift is %.3g, where 1 is the width of one texture tile.
gdc.model.warn.uv1Both: %sThe second texture (detail or lightmap) has moved (biggest shift %.3g, where 1 is one texture tile wide) and is upside down on %zu corners.
gdc.model.warn.uv1Lost: %sThe second texture placement (detail or lightmap) was not saved.
gdc.model.warn.colorLost: %sPainted colors on the points were not saved.
gdc.model.warn.colorDiff: %sPainted colors differ by up to %d out of 255, so the tint on the mesh may look different.
gdc.model.warn.colorFar: %sPainted colors are far from the original (up to %d out of 255). The tint on the mesh will not match.
gdc.model.warn.tangentAngle: %sBump-map direction differs by up to %.2f degrees, so grooves may catch the light differently.
gdc.model.warn.tangentMirror: %sThe bump map is mirrored on %zu corners, so grooves may poke out instead of in.
gdc.model.warn.tangentBoth: %sBump-map direction differs by up to %.2f degrees, and it is mirrored on %zu corners, so grooves may poke out instead of in.
gdc.model.warn.materialChanged: %s%zu triangles use a different material, so those faces may show the wrong texture.
gdc.model.warn.skinOk: %sThe bones pull %zu points the same way as in the original, so bending should look the same.
gdc.model.warn.skinDiff: %sThe bones pull %zu points differently, by up to %.4f where 1 means fully attached to one bone. Joints may bend a little differently.
gdc.model.warn.skinMissing: %sThe bones pull %zu points differently, by up to %.4f where 1 means fully attached to one bone, and %zu bone links were dropped. Those points may not follow every bone.
gdc.model.warn.skinRigid: The original bends with bones, but the result is a solid shape that will not flex (%d parts).
gdc.model.warn.animMissing: Animation "%s" was not saved, so that motion will not play.
gdc.model.warn.animLost: %zu animations were not saved, so the model stays still.
gdc.model.warn.animBad: Animation "%s" does not match: %zu of %zu moving parts were left out, rotation differs by up to %.2f degrees, position by up to %.3g, and the length changed from %.3f to %.3f seconds. The motion may look wrong or cut short.
gdc.model.warn.namesParts: Some part names were lost (%zu of %zu kept, missing %s). The game finds parts by name, so those parts may not be used.
gdc.model.warn.namesMats: Some material names were lost (%zu of %zu kept, missing %s). Those faces may not get the right material.
gdc.model.warn.renamed: %zu repeated names got a letter added, because names in a shape must be unique (%s).
gdc.model.warn.nodesExtra: %zu parts are in the result but not in the original (%s). The game may pick up parts that were never there.
gdc.model.warn.treeParent: %zu parts hang under a different parent (%s). Anything attached to them moves with the wrong part.
gdc.model.warn.poseMoved: %zu parts are in a different place (%s), turned by up to %.2f degrees and moved by up to %.3g. Anything mounted on them ends up in the wrong spot.
gdc.model.warn.treeOk: Parts: all %zu are kept, under the same parents and in the same places.
gdc.model.warn.meshNamesNone: This format does not store mesh names, so they were not checked.
gdc.model.warn.meshNamesLost: %zu of %zu mesh names were lost (%s). The game finds meshes by name, so those meshes may not show up.
gdc.model.warn.meshNamesExtra: %zu meshes in the result are not in the original (%s).
gdc.model.warn.meshOwner: %zu meshes hang on a different part (%s), so they move with the wrong part.
gdc.model.warn.detailSizes: Detail levels changed (result %s, original %s). The model may show the wrong version at a distance.
gdc.model.warn.detailsOk: Detail levels: all %zu kept with the same sizes.
gdc.model.warn.matsExtra: %zu materials are used in the result but not in the original (%s).
gdc.model.warn.matsUnused: %zu materials that no triangle uses were left out (%s).
gdc.model.warn.matCounts: %s%zu materials cover a different number of triangles (%s).
gdc.model.warn.objectChanged: %s%zu triangles ended up in a different mesh, so they show, hide or move with the wrong part.
gdc.model.warn.morphs: Shape changes: kept %d of %d. The rest were dropped, so those changes will not play.
gdc.model.warn.nan: The file contains %zu broken numbers. Parts of the model may be missing, huge, or in the wrong place.
gdc.model.warn.flat: %zu new triangles are completely flat, so they add nothing you can see.
gdc.model.warn.upUnread: Could not check which way is up: %s. If the model lies on its side, the up direction is wrong.
gdc.model.warn.upWrong: The file says %s is up, but this format should use %s as up. The model will lie on its side or face the wrong way.
gdc.model.warn.upSizeOk: The saved size matches the original.
gdc.model.warn.upSmaller: The saved model is smaller than the original, so some parts were left out.
gdc.model.warn.upSize: The saved size is %.3g x %.3g x %.3g, but %.3g x %.3g x %.3g was expected, so the model was turned or scaled.
gdc.model.warn.unitScale: The game scales this model by %.4g because of the file's unit setting, so it will not match the original size. The scale needs to be 1.
gdc.model.warn.unitOk: One unit stays one meter, which is what the game uses.
gdc.model.warn.lodNoNames: This format does not keep part names. The game will not see detail levels or collision meshes, so you get one version of the model and no collision.
gdc.model.warn.lodMissing: The game cannot find the detail levels. It looks for a part named "base" with a part named "start" inside it, and the top of this file is "%s" instead. Without that, the model is usually invisible in the game.
gdc.model.warn.lodOk: Detail levels are in the place the game looks for them.
gdc.model.warn.namesStoredOk: Part names are stored exactly as in the original.
gdc.model.warn.namesStored: %zu part names are stored under a different name in the file (%s). The game and Blender read the stored name, so the game will not find those parts.
gdc.model.warn.importNamesOk: Blender will import materials, parts and meshes under their own names.
gdc.model.warn.matSplit: %zu materials are used both on meshes with painted vertex colors and on meshes without (%s). Blender imports each of them twice, the second copy as name.001.
gdc.model.warn.nodesRepeated: %zu part names are used more than once (%s). Blender renames the copies (name.001) and the game finds only one of them.
gdc.model.warn.meshesRepeated: %zu mesh names are shared by different parts (%s). Blender renames the copies (name.001).
gdc.model.warn.matRepeated: %zu material names appear more than once (%s). Blender renames the copies (name.001) and the game cannot tell them apart.
gdc.model.warn.notChecked: This format cannot be opened again after writing, so the result was not compared with the original. Open the file and look at it before you rely on it.
gdc.model.warn.reread: Could not open the written file to check it against the original: %s
gdc.model.note.colladaUp: The file treated %s as up. It was turned so Z is up, which is what the game uses.
gdc.model.note.morphSkin: "%s" bends with bones and also has shape changes. Shape changes on a bending mesh are not kept, so those changes will not play.
gdc.model.note.morphCount: The pieces of "%s" do not all have the same number of shape changes, so the shape changes were left out.
gdc.model.note.pointsLines: Points and lines on "%s" (mesh "%s") were skipped. Only solid triangles are kept, so those strokes will be missing.
gdc.model.note.pointsLinesBare: Points and lines on "%s" were skipped. Only solid triangles are kept, so those strokes will be missing.
gdc.model.note.boneLoose: Bone "%s" on "%s" is not connected to the skeleton, so it was attached to the root. That part may not bend in the right place.
gdc.model.note.boneCap: On "%s", %zu points were pulled by more than %d bones. The weakest links were dropped, so bending there may be a little stiffer.
gdc.model.note.vertAnim: Animation "%s" moves individual points. That was skipped; only movement of whole parts and bones is kept.
gdc.model.note.scaleAvg: Animation "%s" stretches by different amounts in each direction. Those were averaged into one stretch, so the squash may look rounder.
gdc.model.note.morphPop: Animation "%s" blends between shapes. Only the strongest shape is kept at each moment, so the change may pop instead of blending.
gdc.model.note.noTriangles: The file has no triangles, so the model will be empty.
gdc.model.note.uvFrames: "%s" has %d texture layouts and only the first was kept. Animated texture sliding will not play.
gdc.model.note.twoBinds: On "%s", bone "%s" is attached in two different ways. Only one was kept, so that bone may bend from the wrong place.
gdc.model.note.scaleRot: Animation "%s" rotates while it stretches. The rotation of the stretch was dropped, so the squash stays lined up with the bone.
gdc.model.note.vis: Animation "%s" shows and hides parts. That was dropped, so those parts stay visible the whole time.
gdc.model.note.matAnim: Animation "%s" changes textures over time. That was dropped, so the texture stays on the first frame.
gdc.model.note.ground: Animation "%s" includes %d frames of the model moving along the ground. That motion was dropped.
gdc.model.note.oldSkin: Some old skin data was not used by any detail level, so it was left out.
gdc.model.note.decals: %d decal meshes were left out. The game no longer uses that kind of mesh.
gdc.model.note.sorted: %d meshes were stored in an old sorted form and were saved as normal meshes. They should look the same.
gdc.model.note.billboard: A billboard setting (%s) was %d, above this file version's limit of %d, so it was reduced. The billboard may look coarser.
gdc.model.note.droppedExtras: Version %d cannot store a second texture or painted colors. They were removed from %zu meshes. Choose version 26 or newer to keep them.
gdc.model.note.bakedSkin: This format cannot store bones, so the mesh was saved in its current pose as a solid shape. It will not bend when animated.
gdc.model.note.lodFold: Removed %d empty grouping parts so the game can still find the detail levels.
gdc.model.err.dtsIndex: DTS version %d can only store up to 65535 points in one mesh, and %zu values are past that. Choose version 26 or newer.
gdc.model.dtsLoss.names: Part names are not listed at the start of the file. The game still opens it, but listing the parts takes longer.
gdc.model.dtsLoss.tangents: Bump-map directions are not saved. The game rebuilds them, so grooves should still catch the light.
gdc.model.dtsLoss.uvColor: The second texture and painted colors are not saved. Choose version 26 or newer to keep them.
gdc.model.dtsLoss.bigMesh: One mesh cannot have more than 65535 points. A larger mesh will be refused; choose version 26 or newer.
gdc.model.dtsLoss.billboard: Billboard settings are stored in an older packed form. Very high settings may be reduced.
gdc.model.dtsLoss.lightmap: This version writes an extra unused lightmap list. It does not change how the model looks.
